title: Punishment Divine
description:
If you aren't a Cleric, you can now **Cast a Spell**+wis with an effect under the War Domain, which you get from a deity. For more details, see the Cleric Starting Move, **Invoke the Divine**.

If you're a Cleric, you can add **War** (or another Domain from Invoke the Divine) to your deity's Domains.

outcomes.text: You can wear **heavy armor**, ignoring the STR requirement, and can wield non-blunt weapons. You can erase 1 Depth with your deity to get **adv** to **Trade Blows** for a Scene. If you're fighting enemies of your deity, you get **adv** to dmg rolls.

title: Rebuke the Unholy
description: When you **shout your deity's name like a battle cry**, erase 1 Depth with them and roll+cha. If you're facing enemies of your deity, you don't need to erase the Depth.

outcomes.text: Your opposition is dazed or flees (GM's call).
They mark a Condition but stand their ground.
Your cry falls on deaf ears; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a move.

title: A Moth to the Sacred Flame
description: When you **willingly expose yourself to an enemy attack**, roll+cha; if you're vulnerable while doing so, roll with **adv**.

outcomes.text: They boast and babble at you, and you can ask any two questions about them or their superiors.
You can ask one question, but after answering they'll turn to violence.
They're far more cunning or powerful than they appear (GM's call); mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Circle of Protection
description: When you **draw a** **holy** **circle on the floor or ground**, erase 1 Depth with your deity and roll+wis.

outcomes.text: It will keep spirits, ghosts, and outsiders in or out until someone else breaks it.
It will keep them in or out momentarily, but not for long.
Your deity's enemies are closer than you think; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a move.

title: Divine Intuition
description: When you **encounter a creature, manifestation, or power from another plane of existence**, you may erase 1 Depth with your deity to ask the GM questions equal to your wis. You get **adv** on your first roll related to the answer(s).
